latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the text-prospecting-sequence-builder skill.

- Builds text prospecting sequences customized for four situations: post-networking, hot inbound, post-voicemail, and post-no-show.
- Enforces permission-based texting: only allows sequence creation if prior contact exists.
- Drafts each message using the Bridge-Because pattern, tailored for short-form SMS.
- Includes message timing, cadence, and per-touch templates with rationale.
- Runs every draft through the 7-rule professional text check for compliance.
- Not suitable for cold outreach; requires prior familiarity with the prospect.
